comparison.objective: Lay a dropped kerb with the correct mirror-image transition kerb at each end; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests heavy component selection, orientation, placement, and edge alignment; candidate tests fine hex-key engagement, counterholding, collar adjustment, torque-limited locking, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correct handed transition placement and kerb layout; candidate requires two safe impact cycles and no lock drift.
comparison.reason: Kerb layout and handed-part placement do not test adjustable damping. No spec versions or joint, level, support, and damage tolerances are stated.
